value.rationale: The original source expressly asks whether its three-cycle may be unique. Here a natural one-parameter quadratic subclass has a sharp, exact transition from three to five primitive three-cycles as two opposite cyclic order types arise. The discriminant 125/12 coincides with the known middle repeated-coordinate branch stability boundary, making the exact finite bifurcation frontier motivated rather than an arbitrary polynomial special value. This classification is a precise invariant of the original discrete dynamical problem, not merely an exercise in factorization.
